method:
Lending markets that take a Pendle principal token (PT) of a depegged
coin (Part A), and the five cases' non-Morpho markets that take the family
coin itself (Part B, s3_state_markets): a state-read estimate of the
depositors' and coin lenders' losses that the case summaries do not size
(hit rules R23).

Why.  A PT is its own contract.  It redeems into the coin only at its
maturity, through Pendle's SY wrapper, so the family rule of R9 (the coin
plus the contracts that redeem into it) never admitted it, and the markets
that take a PT as collateral entered no event.  The five case summaries
list some PT markets that their surface matched by symbol prefix; this
stage finds all of them by contract and sizes the ones not yet counted.

What, per event (the five reconstructed cases and the five other lending
census events of event_sizing.json):

  1. PTs.  Every Pendle yield-contract factory event on every HyperSync
     chain, CreateYieldContract(SY, expiry, PT, YT) (explicit topic0), and
     every CreateNewMarket(market, PT, ...) for the PT's AMM.  Each PT is
     checked on chain (PT.SY(), PT.YT(), PT.expiry() equal the event's),
     and its SY is read: yieldToken(), assetInfo().  A PT belongs to a
     family when the SY's yield token or accounting asset is one of the
     family's contracts (R9 identity by contract; the family lists come
     from the recovery-price deployments, the price census universe and
     the S1 unwrap chains, see FAMILY_SOURCES), or, one level further,
     when the yield token is an ERC-4626 whose asset() is (flagged
     `second_level`, e.g. Kelp's agETH over rsETH).
  2. Markets.  Every census-universe row (s2/universe.jsonl) whose
     collateral or loan side, or whose Silo / Gearbox token list, is such
     a PT; the S1 factory enumerations (s1/markets) as a cross-check; and
     for the span after S1's scan, fresh HyperSync scans of Morpho
     CreateMarket, Euler ProxyCreated + GovSetLTV (topic1 = the PT's
     collateral vault) and Silo NewSilo (topic2/topic3 = the PT), all
     with explicit topic0.  Aave/Spark reserve lists are read at the
     valuation block.
  3. Blocks.  Each event's hit rules section-5 snapshot and its price
     onset, per chain: for a case, caps.json.meta.json snapshot_blocks and
     summary.loan_side_basis.onset_blocks; a chain missing there is
     resolved from the case window (t0 - 24h, else onset - 24h; the onset
     time); for the other events, novel_sizing's snapshot and onset times
     (blocks resolved per chain).  Valuation: RELEASE_VALUATION_TS, the
     price census's block per chain where it recorded one.
  4. Reads (Multicall3), at the snapshot, the onset and the valuation
     block:
       morpho   market(id), interest accrued to the block through the
                IRM's borrowRateView (MorphoBalancesLib's rule), the
                oracle's price(), and position(id, a) for every account in
                the market's Borrow / SupplyCollateral / WithdrawCollateral
                / Liquidate logs: debt and PT units by position
       euler    lending vault totalBorrows, cash, interestAccumulator; per
                borrower (Borrow logs) debtOf, the PT collateral vault's
                balanceOf x convertToAssets, and EVC.getCollaterals; a
                borrower is attributed to the PT only when every enabled
                collateral holding a balance is a PT vault of the family
                (the s3_novel_state rule); the router's getQuote for the
                PT vault
       silo v2  borrower by borrower (loan silo Borrow / Repay logs): a
                borrower is attributed when SiloConfig.borrowerCollateral
                Silo() names the PT silo (same-asset borrowers name the loan
                silo and are not PT-backed); debt = the loan silo's maxRepay,
                PT = the PT silo's collateral and protected shares converted
                to assets; the loan silo's totals for context
       gearbox  creditAccounts(), creditAccountInfo() principal, balances;
                an account is attributed when the PT is its one collateral
                besides the borrowed asset
     Pendle, per PT at the same blocks: SY.exchangeRate(),
     YT.pyIndexStored(), YT.postExpiry(), and the PT's AMM _storage()
     (lastLnImpliedRate).
  5. Value.  One PT is worth PT->asset / index x P(yield token): after
     maturity PT->asset = 1 and the index is the YT's frozen
     firstPYIndex (the SY units a PT redeems for); before maturity
     PT->asset = exp(-lastLnImpliedRate x time to expiry / 365 days) from
     Pendle's own AMM and the index is the SY rate at the block.  P(yield
     token) at the valuation block is the recovery price
     (recovery_prices.json for the case tokens, event_sizing.json
     and the price census for the others; ETH units at the census FX), at
     the snapshot and the onset the price census's series (last sample at
     or before the block).  The variant 'one_for_one' values a matured PT
     at one unit of the SY's accounting asset, as a PT pays at maturity in
     asset terms.
  6. Ledger, per market at the valuation block:
       depositors  shortfall = max(debt - PT collateral value, 0), the
                   market netted (positions summed: a variant); the
                   pinned-rate phantom interest split as s3_summary does:
                   interest accrued after the snapshot is removed pro rata
                   (Morpho: debt(val) - debt(snap) - borrows + repays +
                   liquidation repays + written-off debt, from logs;
                   elsewhere the borrow index snapshot / valuation);
                   plus debt written off between the onset and the
                   valuation block (Morpho Liquidate badDebtAssets, Euler
                   DebtSocialized, with tx hashes)
       outflow     net new borrowing between the snapshot and the onset
                   (logs), counted when the PT's oracle value exceeded its
                   market value at the onset block (both recorded); variant
                   'extractable': only when the oracle value x the
                   liquidation LTV exceeded the market value (a loan at the
                   limit worth more than the collateral)
       checks      the principal as cash never returned (borrows - repays -
                   liquidation repays - written-off debt, whole log history,
                   capped at the debt) beside the index split; a market is
                   flagged pre_event_insolvent when at the snapshot its
                   PT-backed debt already exceeded the PT's market value at
                   99% utilization or more: its figures are reported apart
                   and not added
       PT lenders  markets that lend the PT: supplied PT at the onset x
                   (1 - PT value at the valuation block), par = one unit
                   of the SY's accounting asset
     Markets already in a case summary's per_market (Morpho, symbol
     matched) keep the case's figure and add nothing.  Euler lending vaults
     in a case summary are there at vault level with no depositor figure,
     so a PT-attributed Euler shortfall adds.  Units: loan assets at par for
     USD majors, WETH at the census FX, a family coin at its recovery
     price.

Additions (the ledger rows).  Per case: depositors + (Part A and Part B
depositor losses of markets not in the case summary, pre-event insolvent
markets left out and recorded), coin lenders + (PT lenders and lenders of
the family coin not already on the summary's loan side), and the offset
the de-duplicated total takes out of the borrower term (units pledged at
the onset on the holder partition's chain, and coin held by a lending
vault or silo at the onset, times the drop, each capped at its
addition).  The other events' row: Part A only, no offset.  The
headline (s7_headline) adds these to its rows; s7_partition dedup takes
the offsets out of the borrower term; release_build check C20.

Output: data/inputs/pt_markets.json (sections pt, family_collateral,
additions) and its .meta.json; --out DIR writes elsewhere.  HyperSync
logs are cached under data/raw/s3/pt_markets_cache/ (delete to re-read).
Every figure carries its block, contract and, for write-offs, the
transaction hash.

Usage: python -m s3.s3_pt_markets [--out DIR] [--cache DIR]


Part B (family_collateral):
Part B of R23: the five cases' non-Morpho markets whose collateral is a
family coin, sized by the state method (no position replay).

The case summaries size the depositors of Morpho markets position by
position (and rsETH's Aave deficit from its decomposition).  Their Euler
vaults enter only at vault level (extraction, flight), with no depositor
figure, and their Silo, Gearbox and Compound markets not at all.  This
part reads those markets at three blocks (the case's snapshot and onset
per chain, and the valuation block) and applies the state method of
s3_novel_state and of Part A (s3_pt_markets):

  euler    per borrower of the lending vault (Borrow / Repay / Liquidate
           logs): debtOf, EVC.getCollaterals and the balance in each; an
           account is attributed when every enabled collateral holding a
           balance is a family vault (coin or PT) and at least one is a
           coin vault (PT-only accounts are Part A's); its collateral is
           the vault shares x convertToAssets, the coin at its recovery
           price, a PT at Part A's value
  silo v2  per borrower of the loan silo whose SiloConfig
           .borrowerCollateralSilo() is the family coin's silo: maxRepay
           and the collateral + protected shares converted to assets
  compound per account with family collateral (SupplyCollateral /
           TransferCollateral logs, asset topic): borrowBalanceOf and
           userCollateral of every listed asset; attributed when the
           family coin is its only collateral
  gearbox  per credit account: principal debt (creditAccountInfo) and
           balances; attributed when family tokens are its only
           collateral besides the borrowed asset

Ledger per market at the valuation block, as in Part A: shortfall =
max(debt - collateral at the recovery price, 0), netted over the
attributed accounts; the pinned-rate interest split pro rata by the
market's borrow index (snapshot / valuation: Euler interestAccumulator,
Silo assets per debt share, Compound baseBorrowIndex; Gearbox reports
principal already); plus bad debt written off between the onset and the
valuation block (Euler DebtSocialized in a transaction whose Liquidate
seized a family vault; Compound AbsorbDebt of an attributed account, less
the family collateral it absorbed at the recovery price; Silo v2 has no
socialization; Gearbox IncurUncoveredLoss on the pool is recorded).
Outflow between the snapshot and the onset: the attributed accounts' net
new debt, counted when the oracle's value of the family collateral x the
liquidation LTV exceeded its market value at the onset (the extractable
rule).  Coin lenders: where a vault or silo lends the family coin and the
case summary does not already count it on the loan side, the supply at
the onset x (basis - recovery price), the basis being the headline's peg
for the case's base coin (xUSD's booked value, R21), a wrapper's rate at
the onset x that peg, and zero drop for rsETH (its rate recovered).

A market is flagged pre_event_insolvent when at the snapshot its
attributed debt already exceeded the collateral's market value at 99%
utilization or more; its figures are reported and not added.  Offsets
against the borrowers column (dedup): on the holder partition's chain,
the family units pledged by attributed accounts at the onset (in the
partition's lending bucket, charged to the borrower term) x the drop,
capped at the depositor addition; and the coin the lending vault or silo
held at the onset x the drop, capped at the coin-lender addition.
